Maya Patel: quick async OKR check — please drop 1) what shipped since last check 2) slipped items + why 3) any ownership swaps/hand-offs 4) blockers. short one-liners pls, I'll roll up.

Ethan Cole: Shipped -> runtime v3 canary autoscale config landed to staging. PR merged, smoke passed. docs draft in PR. @Priya can you confirm QA? :thumbsup:

Priya Sinha: QA -> did a quick smoke. Found cold-start latency spike on long sequences (10k tokens). Filed bug #324: https://tracker/324. Repro steps in the ticket. Recommend hold GA by 1 week unless we mitigate cache warmup. :thinking_face:

Jordan Lee: Slipped -> embedding cache optimization slipped. Blocked by eng-infra network policy change. Ownership swap: I'm handing temporary ownership to Ethan for unblock. Maya — I'll add to the rollout board.

Ethan Cole: I can take embedding cache opt. I'll open an infra ticket and loop eng-infra. CR ping: need 2 reviewers for the perf patch (estimating small diff). @Priya can you do perf sign-off after infra fix?

Priya Sinha: yes, happy to sign off after regression run. ETA Tue morning for perf check.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy/runtime-v3 started at 2025-11-04T15:20:12Z — monitoring enabled.

Maya Patel: blocker -> Dedicated capacity SLA negotiation stuck; legal needs a short security feed from Sales to proceed. Jordan, can you loop in Sales and ask for the standard security one-pager?

Jordan Lee: on it — pinged Alex from Sales. Also note docs gap: README for new autoscale flags is missing. Ethan, can you drop a short README in the repo?

Ethan Cole: added README draft to the canary PR (link in PR comments). Also created a tiny checklist for rollout:``
- merge autoscale config
- infra policy fix
- perf sign-off
- docs publish
- GA announce
```

Maya Patel: thanks. Quick rollup for the doc: shipped = runtime v3 canary autoscale config; slipped = embedding cache optimization (owner swapped to Ethan) because of infra network policy; QA blocker = cold-start latency bug #324 (Priya); legal/Sales action = security one-pager for Dedicated SLA (Jordan -> Sales). Owners: Ethan (embeddings + README + rollout), Priya (QA sign-off), Jordan (sales/legal handoff). I'll build the short update for execs by EOD. If anything changes, ping here. :white_check_mark:
